question: Does v4's constrained-DAS intervention family actually partition the exact multi-site patch, and did its optimizer beat the search-free difference-in-means baseline on its own registered training loss?

frozen_design.sets: all seven v4 unit sets, unchanged and in their recorded order
frozen_design.rows: even A1 fit rows used by v4
frozen_design.closure_test: compare exact overwrite q=None with q=I, which applies the full cached donor-minus-base delta; report per-logit and recovery gaps
frozen_design.baseline_test: evaluate difference-in-means under exactly v4's raw-axis match MSE plus lambda=1 complement-to-base MSE
frozen_design.optimizer_reference: compare that objective with v4's recorded final constrained-DAS loss for the same set

predictions.pred_a_same_layer_identity_closes: the numbered-list two-head same-layer set has maximum per-logit q=I versus exact error <= 1e-4
predictions.pred_b_all_multilayer_identity_closes: every multi-layer set has maximum per-logit q=I versus exact error <= 1e-4
predictions.pred_c_cdas_beat_dim_on_own_loss: for both MLP-containing sets, v4's final constrained-DAS joint training loss is <= the difference-in-means joint training loss

terminal_rules.instrument_invalid: same-layer identity closure exceeds 1e-4 or native instrument closure fails
terminal_rules.v4_partition_invalid: instrument is valid but any multi-layer full-rank identity closure exceeds 1e-4
terminal_rules.target_generalization_mismatch: pred_c holds while difference-in-means remains better on the already-recorded held-out causal/complement bars

interpretation_limits: No direction is refit and no threshold is changed after inspecting the audit.
A q=I closure failure invalidates the claim that q and its complement partition the exact multi-site intervention; it does not invalidate whole-unit patching.
Even a passing training-loss comparison cannot establish uniqueness or held-out causal validity.
